title: Check Selected Robot Details (Robot ID, Location, Node Code/Cell Code, Tote ID) in Robot Selection Overview
summary: Use the live RMS / fleet status UI Robot Selection Overview to select a robot and read its robot ID, location, node code (cell code), and tote presence/ID indicators—including the “?” tote mismatch case and the “layer_1” case when no tote is carried.
when_to_use: When you need to identify which robot is involved in an issue by checking the selected robot’s identifiers and tote status in the Robot Selection Overview detail panel.
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Execute the Robot Selection Overview selection and read robot ID, location, node code (cell code), and tote indicators from the expanded detail panel.

system_preconditions: Robot Selection Overview is available in the RMS / fleet status UI.

visual_references.description: Robot Selection Overview panel showing: Robot x Robot option, selecting a robot (box/outline), expandable detail section (small arrow), and the robot detail fields/indicators (robot ID/location, node code/cell code, tote ID with leading “?”, and “layer_1” when no tote).

steps.title: Open Robot Selection Overview and ensure Robot x Robot mode
steps.purpose: Ensure the UI is in the correct mode so selecting a robot populates the robot detail panel.
steps.instruction: In the RMS / fleet status UI (rms_ui), open the Robot Selection Overview screen and ensure the view is in “Robot x Robot” mode (Robot option selected).
steps.expected_result: The Robot Selection Overview shows the Robot x Robot / Robot option selected and a robot list/grid that can be clicked to select a robot.
steps.healthy_condition: Selecting robots in the panel will show a selected robot box/outline and populate robot details in the expandable detail panel.
steps.failure_condition: The UI does not respond to robot selection (no selected box/outline) or robot detail fields do not populate.

actions.label: Verify Robot x Robot mode
actions.exact_action: Ensure the view is in “Robot x Robot” mode (Robot option selected).

stop_or_escalate_if: Robot ID/location/tote fields do not populate after selecting a robot (possible UI disconnect or not updating).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Robot selection overview: click a robot to select; selected robot has a box; small arrow expands hidden detail section; read robot ID and location; node code is cell code; tote ID shown under robot ID; tote with leading '?' means robot removed but tote not; if no tote, UI shows 'layer_1' and no brown-box tote indicator.

steps.title: Select the robot in the panel
steps.purpose: Load the selected robot’s details into the detail panel for verification.
steps.instruction: Click a specific robot on the Robot Selection Overview panel so it becomes the selected robot (it should show a box/outline around the selected robot).
steps.expected_result: A box/outline appears around the selected robot, indicating it is the active selection.
steps.healthy_condition: The selected robot box/outline is visible and the detail panel is ready to show robot-specific fields.
steps.failure_condition: No box/outline appears around the robot after clicking, or the selection does not update the detail panel.

actions.label: Click robot to select
actions.exact_action: Click a specific robot on the panel so it becomes the selected robot (it should show a box/outline around the selected robot).

stop_or_escalate_if: Robot ID/location/tote fields do not populate after selecting a robot (possible UI disconnect or not updating).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: The robot selected will have a box around it showing its selected.

steps.title: Expand the robot detail section if hidden
steps.purpose: Reveal the full robot detail information needed for ID/location/node code/tote verification.
steps.instruction: If the robot detail section is hidden, click the small arrow control to expand it so the full robot detail information is visible.
steps.expected_result: The expanded detail panel displays the robot ID, location, node code (cell code), and tote indicator fields.
steps.healthy_condition: The detail panel expands successfully and shows all relevant fields/indicators.
steps.failure_condition: The detail section cannot be expanded (small arrow does not reveal details).

actions.label: Expand details
actions.exact_action: Click the small arrow and it will show up / expand to all the details.

stop_or_escalate_if: Detail section cannot be expanded (small arrow does not reveal details).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: If this detail section is ever hidden, you can click on the small arrow and it will show up. It will expand to all the details.

steps.title: Record/verify robot ID and location
steps.purpose: Confirm the selected robot identity and its current location for issue correlation.
steps.instruction: In the expanded details, record/verify the robot ID and location fields for the selected robot.
steps.expected_result: The detail panel shows robot ID and location values for the selected robot.
steps.healthy_condition: Robot ID and location fields populate and correspond to the selected robot.
steps.failure_condition: Robot ID/location fields do not populate after selecting the robot or expanding details.

actions.label: Read robot ID and location
actions.exact_action: Look at the robot ID and location.

stop_or_escalate_if: Robot ID/location fields do not populate after selecting a robot (possible UI disconnect or not updating).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Important details include robot ID and location.

steps.title: Verify node code (cell code) for the robot
steps.purpose: Confirm the robot’s node code matches the cell code reference used on the floor/map.
steps.instruction: Verify the node code field and confirm it corresponds to the cell code for the robot (use the displayed node code value as the cell code reference).
steps.expected_result: The detail panel shows a node code value, and you treat that node code as the cell code for the robot.
steps.healthy_condition: Node code is present and can be used as the cell code reference for the robot’s location.
steps.failure_condition: Node code field is missing or does not populate after selection/expansion.

actions.label: Read node code
actions.exact_action: The note code is pretty much the cell code for the robot.

stop_or_escalate_if: Node code field does not populate after selecting a robot (possible UI disconnect or not updating).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: The note code is pretty much the cell code for the robot.

steps.title: Check tote ID/presence under the robot ID
steps.purpose: Determine whether the robot is carrying a tote, and detect tote mismatch after robot removal.
steps.instruction: Under the robot ID in the tote section, check the tote entry: if a tote ID is shown (e.g., “tote #96”), note the tote ID.
steps.expected_result: A tote ID value is shown under the robot ID when the robot has a tote.
steps.healthy_condition: Tote ID is present under the robot ID when the robot is carrying a tote.
steps.failure_condition: Tote ID is not shown when a tote is expected, or tote indicators do not populate after selection/expansion.

actions.label: Read tote ID
actions.exact_action: You see that you have the robot ID as well as something called the 9696. This indicates that this robot has a tote, and this is the tote's ID.

stop_or_escalate_if: Tote fields do not populate after selecting a robot (possible UI disconnect or not updating).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: When you click on the robot... you see that you have the robot ID as well as something called the 9696... This indicates that this robot has a tote, and this is the tote's ID.

steps.title: Interpret leading “?” tote mismatch indicator
steps.purpose: Detect the specific mismatch state where the robot was removed but the tote was not.
steps.instruction: If the tote entry shows a “?” before the tote value, interpret it as: the robot was removed but the tote was not (tote mismatch).
steps.expected_result: A leading “?” appears before the tote value, indicating robot removed but tote not removed.
steps.healthy_condition: The UI clearly shows “?” before the tote value in the tote section under the robot ID.
steps.failure_condition: The tote mismatch indicator is not shown when the tote mismatch condition is suspected, or tote indicators do not populate after selection/expansion.

actions.label: Check for leading '?'
actions.exact_action: If the tote has a "?" before it, that means the robot has been removed but the tote has not.

stop_or_escalate_if: Tote fields do not populate after selecting a robot (possible UI disconnect or not updating).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: If the tote has a "?" before it, that means the robot has been removed but the tote has not.

steps.title: Confirm no-tote state shows “layer_1” and no brown-box tote indicator
steps.purpose: Confirm the robot is not carrying a tote and capture the UI’s explicit no-tote indicator.
steps.instruction: If no tote is present, confirm the UI shows “layer_1” and that the brown-box tote indicator is not shown.
steps.expected_result: The tote section indicates “layer_1” and there is no brown-box tote indicator.
steps.healthy_condition: No tote state is represented by “layer_1” with no brown-box tote indicator.
steps.failure_condition: Brown-box tote indicator appears when “layer_1” is expected, or the tote section does not show “layer_1” when no tote is present.

actions.label: Check layer_1 no-tote indicator
actions.exact_action: If a robot doesn't have a tote it will say layer_1.

stop_or_escalate_if: Tote fields do not populate after selecting a robot (possible UI disconnect or not updating).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: If a robot doesn't have a tote it will say layer_1... If the robot doesn't is not carrying any tote, you will not see this brown box at all on the tote section.

success_criteria: You can identify the selected robot’s robot ID and location from the expanded Robot Selection Overview detail panel.
You can read the node code value and use it as the cell code reference for the robot.
You can determine tote state from the tote section: tote ID present, leading “?” tote mismatch, or “layer_1” no-tote state.
healthy_conditions: Selected robot shows a box/outline around it.
Detail section expands via the small arrow and shows robot ID, location, node code, and tote indicators.
Tote indicators match one of the supported states: tote ID present, leading “?” mismatch, or “layer_1” with no brown-box tote indicator.
failure_conditions: Detail section cannot be expanded (small arrow does not reveal details).
Robot ID/location/tote fields do not populate after selecting a robot.
Node code field is missing or does not populate after selection/expansion.
escalation_guidance: If the detail section cannot be expanded or robot ID/location/tote fields do not populate after selecting a robot, stop and escalate to deeper RMS/WCS diagnostics (L2_support) because the UI may be disconnected or not updating.
missing_details: The packet does not provide the exact RMS screen name/menu path for “Robot Selection Overview”; it only specifies the Robot Selection Overview screen and the Robot x Robot mode behavior.
